author: caffeinated_boi
body:
Both games are worth starting, it just depends on your preferences.
They're updated regularly, pretty much all content gets introduced to both games at the same time. Main difference is that Orna is GPS based and Aethric has its own map and is meant to be played more like a classical RPG.

In my opinion Aethric is a bit simpler to get started and it's not "gated" behind the GPS factor (even though after unlocking Wayvessels in Orna you can pretty much get access to everything without moving)

author: Warfnair
body: Orna ftw. HoA is just a spinoff for couch potatoes!
